title: Gold benchmark abc_00000003_bc4
description:
Static linear-elastic analysis of the part in geometry.step (third-party CAD 00000003_1ffb81a71e5b402e966b9341_step_002.step, rescaled to SI metres; bounding-box diagonal 100.0 mm).
Material: isotropic linear elastic steel, E = 210 GPa, Poisson's ratio 0.3. No gravity.
Faces are named f<tag> by their OCC face tag in this STEP file; positions below are in mm.
Clamped (all displacements zero): face f20 (centroid (0.00, 0.00, 27.56) mm, area 5091.2 mm^2).
Uniform pressure 10.8 MPa pushing into the part on face f3 (centroid (27.19, 0.00, 30.59) mm, area 736.6 mm^2).
All other faces are free.
Report: strain_energy (J); u_max = maximum displacement magnitude (m); vm_mean = volume-average von Mises stress (Pa); u_mean_<face> = mean displacement magnitude over each loaded face (m); with several supports, the support reactions R<x|y|z>_<face> (N).
